instruction: What is the title of the oldest released song in my Spotify account from across my song, album and playlist libraries?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are required, only the answer (title of the oldest-released song across song, album and playlist libraries). The three listing actions assert knowledge predicates that gate spotify-show-song (the candidate song ids are only known after all three libraries are listed). The single spotify-show-song step in the plan stands for the runtime loop that fetches release dates for library/playlist songs and then reads the title of the song with the minimum release date; album songs use the album's release_date. Pagination (page_index) is an execution detail handled by the executor rather than modeled. The object oldest-released-song is a placeholder for whichever song id turns out oldest; is-oldest is a static marker tying the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task to that entity. supervisor-complete-task is structurally last: all other actions require (not (task-completed)).
